page.content:
The National Basketball Association — drafts, dynasties, and the Finals.

How NBA connects

  • Event: NBA Finals — The NBA Finals are the league's championship series.
  • Item: Larry O'Brien Trophy — The Larry O'Brien Trophy is the NBA championship prize.
  • Character: David Stern — David Stern was the commissioner who globalized the NBA.
  • Faction: Boston Celtics — The Boston Celtics are the NBA's most titled franchise.
  • Faction: Los Angeles Lakers — The Los Angeles Lakers are the other pole of the league's central rivalry.
  • Event: NBA draft — The NBA draft is the league's annual entry auction.
  • Concept: Celtics–Lakers rivalry — The Celtics–Lakers rivalry is the NBA's longest title argument.
  • Character: Adam Silver — Adam Silver succeeded Stern as NBA commissioner.
  • Faction: Chicago Bulls — The Chicago Bulls are the franchise of the 1990s global dynasty.
  • Faction: Golden State Warriors — The Golden State Warriors are the franchise of the shooting dynasty.
  • Event: NBA All-Star Game — The All-Star Game is the NBA's midseason exhibition.
  • Faction: Dream Team — The Dream Team was the NBA's Olympic export.
  • Location: Madison Square Garden — Madison Square Garden is the NBA's most famous regular house.

What is NBA?

The NBA is the U.S. and Canadian professional basketball league whose lore runs through Bill Russell's Celtics, the Lakers rivalry, the Bulls dynasty, the Warriors' shooting revolution, the draft, and the Larry O'Brien Trophy.

Key threads lead to NBA Finals, Larry O'Brien Trophy, David Stern, Boston Celtics, Los Angeles Lakers and NBA draft.
